sentences.c: "What do scientists you've spoken with think about that?"—"Well, to begin with, they doubt it's going to work."
sentences.cn: “和你交谈过的科学家们对此怎么看？”——“噢，首先，他们怀疑这是否会奏效。”

trans.cn: 相信，信任

sentences.c: I ask you to believe in yourself and your mission.
sentences.cn: 我请求你们相信自己和自己的使命。

sentences.c: I choose to believe in hard work, but not so much in talent.
sentences.cn: 我选择相信努力工作，但不太相信天赋。

sentences.c: You have to believe in yourself.
sentences.cn: 你必须相信你自己。

trans.cn: 应归入（类别、范畴等）

sentences.c: but they can claim to belong in the same league.
sentences.cn: 但却可说他们属于同一阵营。

sentences.c: They may not have the name recognition of a Google or a Yahoo!, but they can claim to belong in the same league.
sentences.cn: 它们也许没有Google或者Yahoo那么高的知名度，但是他们可以宣称属于同一个阵营。

sentences.c: The bears seem to belong in those Rocky Mountain river valleys; the redwoods seem to belong on those coastal hills, and the alligators seem to belong in those plains.
sentences.cn: 熊似乎就应该在河边峡谷的岩石山里；红木应该在海岸山丘上，而鳄鱼则该呆在大草原。

trans.cn: 属于；是…的成员

sentences.c: I used to belong to a youth club.
sentences.cn: 我曾是一个青年俱乐部的成员。

sentences.c: While the two are only days apart in age they seem to belong to wholly different generations.
sentences.cn: 虽然这两位年龄上只有几天之差，但他们好像属于完全不同年代的人。

sentences.c: They want to belong to Europe.
sentences.cn: 他们想使自己归属于欧洲。

trans.cn: 从…中收益

sentences.c: Who exactly stands to benefit from these changes?
sentences.cn: 到底是谁会从这些变革中直接获益？

sentences.c: Small businesses are well situated to benefit from the single market.
sentences.cn: 小企业所处的形势有利于从单一市场中受益。

sentences.c: The hosts stand to benefit from the funds' capital.
sentences.cn: 东道主的受益来自基金的资本。

trans.cn: 把…归咎于

sentences.c: Any inappropriate part in his translation must not be to blame on them, but on the author himself.
sentences.cn: 而译文中任何不当之处都与他们毫无关系，一概由作者自己负责。

sentences.c: You can't put all the blame on him. It takes two to make a marriage.
sentences.cn: 你不能全责怪他，结婚是两个人的事。

sentences.c: Ms. Carey appeared to blame her breakdown on EMI's punishing work schedule.
sentences.cn: 凯丽女士看来是将自己的崩溃归咎于百代公司紧张的工作安排。

trans.cn: 接界，接壤；近似，接近

sentences.c: The UN convoy was mined on its way to the border.
sentences.cn: 联合国车队在驶往边界的途中触雷被炸。

sentences.c: On Sunday the horses were harnessed to a heavy wagon for a day-long ride over the border.
sentences.cn: 星期天这些马被套在一辆沉重的货车上，踏上长达一天的旅程越过边境。

sentences.c: I figure they probably had to refuel and launch from one of these bases that's right on the border.
sentences.cn: 我想他们可能要从边界上的某个基地加油然后发射。

trans.cn: 闯入
打断；闯进；打扰

sentences.c: She longed to break in on their conversation but didn't want to appear rude.
sentences.cn: 她很想打断他们的谈话，但又不愿显得粗鲁。

sentences.c: It's impolite to break in on other people's conversation.
sentences.cn: 打断他人的谈话是不礼貌的。

sentences.c: He longed to break in on their conversation but didn't want to appear rude.
sentences.cn: 他很想打断他们的谈话，但又不想显得很粗鲁。

trans.cn: 打扰；打断，闯进
分成（部分）
闯入：指非法进入某个地方或建筑物，尤指为了犯罪目的而进入。
开始从事：指开始从事某个新的领域、行业或职业。
突然开始：指突然开始进行某个活动或状态。

sentences.c: They had to break into the emergency food supplies.
sentences.cn: 他们不得不动用应急食物。

sentences.c: There was no one nearby who might see him trying to break into the house.
sentences.cn: 当时附近没有人可能看见他试图闯进那所房子。

sentences.c: He'd been out of work and he chose to break into a house to get money for his family.
sentences.cn: 他失业了，并选择入室抢劫来赚钱支撑家庭。

trans.cn: 打碎；结束；驱散；散开；分解
分裂，分散：将某物分成许多片或将某物分成许多片。

sentences.c: Police had to break up the crowd.
sentences.cn: 警方不得不驱散人群。

sentences.c: Police used tear gas to break up a demonstration.
sentences.cn: 警察使用了催泪瓦斯来驱散示威活动。

sentences.c: Riot police used tear gas to break up the demonstration.
sentences.cn: 防暴警察使用了催泪瓦斯驱散示威游行。

trans.cn: 导致，引起，使发生
引起，导致某事发生：指通过某种行动或方式引发或导致某事物的发生。

sentences.c: Interest-rate cuts have failed to bring about economic recovery.
sentences.cn: 利率的降低未能带来经济的复苏。

sentences.c: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace.
sentences.cn: 他敦促美国坚持努力实现和平。

sentences.c: His avowed intention was to bring about reform and spiritual renewal for the church.
sentences.cn: 他公开宣称他目标是进行教会改革和灵性的复兴。

synos.cn: 导致；带来；实现；使发生；使帆船改向

trans.cn: 把…带来；使转变

sentences.c: I don't understand. Your dad asked me to bring over all my stuff on homeschooling. Aah! After Christmas, we can reevaluate.
sentences.cn: 我不太明白，你爸爸要我，把东西都带来给做你家教。圣诞之后，我们就可以重新评估一下了。

sentences.c: I tell you what, I'll bring the beer over to your house.
sentences.cn: 你听我的，由我带啤酒到你家来。

sentences.c: We had to make several trips to bring all the equipment over.
sentences.cn: 我们往返了几次才把全部设备运过来。

trans.cn: 教育，培养；提出（供讨论或促使注意）
使恢复知觉：使某人从昏迷、晕厥或麻醉状态中恢复过来。
使停止：使船只或其他交通工具停止前进。

sentences.c: What does Dave ask Alice to bring to the concert?
sentences.cn: 戴夫让爱丽丝带什么去音乐会？

sentences.c: It is the effect on US power and thus on all of us that Richard Haas wants to bring to our attention.
sentences.cn: 美国所受到的影响会最终转嫁到我们每个人身上，这也是理查德哈斯希望能引起我们警惕的。

sentences.c: Hema Xiansheng CEO Hou Yi visited Rwanda to find quality products to bring to the Chinese market.
sentences.cn: 盒马鲜生CEO侯毅前往卢旺达寻找优质产品，并将其带到中国市场。

trans.cn: 增长，增强，逐渐积聚，集结

sentences.c: He stumped around the country trying to build up support.
sentences.cn: 他在全国各地巡回演讲，争取更多的支持。

sentences.c: The police are trying to build up a picture of what happened.
sentences.cn: 警方正试图掌握事情发生的经过。

sentences.c: It may take a few weeks for you to build up your strength again.
sentences.cn: 可能需要几个星期你才能恢复体力。

trans.cn: 打电话；使想起，使忆起

sentences.c: It will be possible to call up on a PC screen millions of volumes from distant libraries.
sentences.cn: 它可以在电脑屏幕上调用远程图书库中的数百万册书卷。

sentences.c: Satan has roused himself from off the burning marl, and he stands in order to call up his fallen minions.
sentences.cn: 撒旦从燃烧的泥灰中苏醒过来，站起来召唤着他同样堕落了的随从们。

sentences.c: Humans, says Edward M. Hallowell, have the ability to call up images of bad things that happened in the past and to anticipate future events.
sentences.cn: 爱德华·哈洛威尔说，人类有能力回忆过去发生的不好的事情，并预测未来的事件。

trans.cn: 对…关切，操心或忧虑

sentences.c: They look too wasted to care about much.
sentences.cn: 他们看上去很憔悴，以至于顾不上太多。

sentences.c: She was too excited to care about the pain.
sentences.cn: 她太兴奋了，根本顾不上疼痛。

sentences.c: I hope to encourage more people to care about pandas.
sentences.cn: 我希望鼓励更多的人关心熊猫。

trans.cn: 喜欢，对…中意；对…担心；照顾，照料
照料：指对某人或某物进行照顾、关心和照料。
关心：指对某人或某事感到关心、在意并给予关注。
照顾：指对某人或某物进行照顾、照料和保护。

sentences.c: They hired a nurse to care for her.
sentences.cn: 他们雇了个护士来照顾她。

sentences.c: His natural mother was unable to care for him so he was raised by an aunt.
sentences.cn: 他的生母不能照顾他，所以他是姑姑抚养大的。

sentences.c: Do you have the ability to care for others?
sentences.cn: 你有能力关心他人吗？

trans.cn: 实行；完成
执行或完成某事，特别是你已经说过你会做或被告知要做的事情：指根据计划或要求进行行动，完成任务或实施计划。

sentences.c: She needed a clear head to carry out her instructions.
sentences.cn: 她需要一个清醒的头脑来执行命令。

sentences.c: She didn't think that he was well enough to carry out such an exacting task.
sentences.cn: 她认为他身体不是很好，不能执行如此艰巨的任务。

sentences.c: She is prepared to carry out her threat to resign.
sentences.cn: 对于将辞职的要挟付诸行动，她已做好了思想准备。

trans.cn: 继续下去，遗留下来

sentences.c: All of her most positive traits have seemed to carry over to her career.
sentences.cn: 她所有的最积极的特质似乎都延续到了她的演艺生涯。

sentences.c: Repeat steps 1-2 for each additional parameter that you wish to carry over.
sentences.cn: 对于希望传递的每个参数，重复步骤1和2。

sentences.c: The templates handle each of the different elements that you want to carry over to the output document.
sentences.cn: 这些模板处理您要带入输出文档的每个不同元素。

trans.cn: 引人注目

sentences.c: The most important purpose is to catch the eye.
sentences.cn: 其最重要的目的是引人注目。

sentences.c: The main purpose of advertising is to catch the eye.
sentences.cn: 广告的主要目的是为了引人注目。

sentences.c: She tries to catch the eye of her friend, Brooke, but Brooke avoids her gaze.
sentences.cn: 她把目光投向朋友布鲁克时，布鲁克却躲开了。

trans.cn: 与…相符，一致

sentences.c: If you're not sure, it is always a good idea to check with your primary care provider.
sentences.cn: 如果您不确定，最好与您的初级保健提供者联系。

sentences.c: I want to check with my secretary before I sign the papers.
sentences.cn: 我要同秘书商量一下再签署这些文件。

sentences.c: "Why don't you tell your friend you have to check with your wife?" she asked.
sentences.cn: “你为什么不告诉你朋友，你得征求妻子的意见？”她问。

trans.cn: 把…从…中清除

sentences.c: It was hard to draw clear lines of demarcation between work and leisure.
sentences.cn: 在工作和闲暇之间很难划出明确的界限。

sentences.c: He tried desperately to wriggle out of giving a clear answer.
sentences.cn: 他竭力支支吾吾不给予明确的回答。

sentences.c: Rick appeared, bending his head a little to clear the top of the door.
sentences.cn: 里克来了，他稍稍低头避开门框。

trans.cn: 相符，一致

sentences.c: The strike was timed to coincide with the party conference.
sentences.cn: 那次罢工选择在召开政党大会的同一时间举行。

sentences.c: He timed the election to coincide with new measures to boost the economy.
sentences.cn: 他把选举的时间安排在振兴经济的新措施出台的时候。

sentences.c: Publication of his biography was timed to coincide with his 70th birthday celebrations.
sentences.cn: 他的传记特别安排在他的70寿诞庆典时出版。

trans.cn: 与…结合（或联合，混合，组合）

sentences.c: When an element is caused to combine with oxygen it is oxidized.
sentences.cn: 当使一种元素与氧化合时，即称其被氧化。

sentences.c: This makes it hard to combine with organic methods (though some researchers are trying).
sentences.cn: 这样就很难采用有机方法了(尽管研究人士仍在继续尝试)。

sentences.c: Because cholesterol can't travel alone through the bloodstream, it has to combine with certain proteins.
sentences.cn: 胆固醇因为不能单独在血液中移动，所以必须和特定的蛋白质结合。

trans.cn: 发生
发生

sentences.c: Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them.
sentences.cn: 耶罗波安却在他们后头设伏兵。

sentences.c: However, this takes time, and the full impact isn't likely to come about until 2008 at the earliest.
sentences.cn: 但是这需要时间，全面的影响直到2008年年初才能看到。

sentences.c: In another win for the good guys, it appears that happiness is more likely to come about spontaneously than is sadness.
sentences.cn: 对于那些心地善良的人来说，会有另外的优势，他们自然而然地更有可能感受到的快乐多于悲伤。

trans.cn: 偶然遇见，碰上
偶然遇见：指在某个地方或某个时间意外地遇到某人或某物。
产生印象：指给人留下某种印象或感觉。
偶然发现：指无意中发现或遇到某事物。

sentences.c: They have to be careful not to come across as disappointed in their child.
sentences.cn: 他们必须小心，不要让自己的孩子对父母感到失望。

sentences.c: Just make sure not to come across as too self-promotional.
sentences.cn: 只需要保证没有太过自我宣传。

sentences.c: I am so blessed to come across you because you make me happy.
sentences.cn: 我是如此幸运邂逅你，因为你让我感到幸福。

trans.cn: 开始做某事，着手

sentences.c: The rapid development of technology enables us to have more opportunities to come into contact with foreign friends to know more about foreign culture and customs.
sentences.cn: 技术的快速发展让我们有更多的机会与外国朋友打交道以了解更多的外国文化和习俗。

sentences.c: I've yet to come into contact with a lackluster professor.
sentences.cn: 我还从来没有接触过一个水平一般般的教授。

sentences.c: Do not allow pet foods to come into contact with human foods.
sentences.cn: 不要让宠物食品与人的食物相接触！

trans.cn: 共计，达到；归结为；涉及，谈到
恢复知觉；苏醒：指从昏迷、晕厥或失去意识的状态中恢复过来。
达到；共计：表示某个数量或程度的总和。
涉及；关于：表示涉及到某个主题或问题。

sentences.c: She's asked him to come to the party.
sentences.cn: 她已邀请他来参加聚会。

sentences.c: I'll be too busy to come to the meeting.
sentences.cn: 我会很忙，不能到会。

sentences.c: We need to come to some form of agreement.
sentences.cn: 我们需要达成某种形式的协议。

trans.cn: 达成协议；妥协，习惯于

sentences.c: An unexplained death is difficult to come to terms with.
sentences.cn: 原因不明的死亡是难以接受的。

sentences.c: It was hard to come to terms with her death after all the support she gave to me and the family.
sentences.cn: 她曾给我和这个家庭很大的帮助，她的去世让人难以接受。

sentences.c: A perfect poem, and one of Dickinson's most compressed and chilling attempts to come to terms with mortality.
sentences.cn: 完美的诗作，迪金森短诗中的一首，一种关于死亡期至的惊悚尝试。

trans.cn: 出现

sentences.c: The daffodils are just beginning to come up.
sentences.cn: 那些水仙花刚开始破土发芽。

sentences.c: The question is bound to come up at the meeting.
sentences.cn: 会上一定会讨论这个问题。

sentences.c: We expect to come up against a lot of opposition to the plan.
sentences.cn: 我们预料这个计划会遭到很多人的反对。

trans.cn: （针对问题，挑战等）提出，想出；提供
想出，提出：指在头脑中产生新的想法或提出新的观点。

sentences.c: We are trying to come up with some ideas to solve the problem.
sentences.cn: 我们正设法想出一些办法来解决这个问题。

sentences.c: "I have to come up with my own way with only 4 fingers," he said.
sentences.cn: “我只有4根手指，必须自己想出方法。”他说。

sentences.c: She trying to come up with a lable to attach to nutria fashions to show it is eco-friendly.
sentences.cn: 她试图想出一个标签，贴在 nutria 时装上，以显示它是环保的。

trans.cn: 对…评论
评论，发表意见：对某事物或某人的言论、行为等进行评论或发表意见。

sentences.c: I forbore to comment on this.
sentences.cn: 我不欲评论它

sentences.c: The minister refused to comment on individual cases.
sentences.cn: 那位部长拒绝对具体个案发表评论。

sentences.c: Doctors are hesitant to comment on the new treatment.
sentences.cn: 医生们不愿对新疗法作出评论。

trans.cn: 自杀
自杀：指故意采取行动以结束自己的生命。
与…比较

sentences.c: Here, the important aspect is to compare with an appropriate reference group.
sentences.cn: 在这里，重要的是与适当的参考组进行比较。

sentences.c: As for holidays, Christmas is nice, but it can never have the meaning for Chinese that Spring Festival has, and the West has nothing to compare with Mid-autumn Festival.
sentences.cn: 至于节日，圣诞节是很好，但它对中国人来说绝对没有春节的意义，西方也没有节日能和中秋节相提并论。

sentences.c: This is exactly what is called shocked to compare with.
sentences.cn: 正所谓不比不知道，一比吓一跳。

trans.cn: 抱怨，发牢骚，诉苦

sentences.c: One day in October, Cho started to complain of headaches and dark, obscured vision.
sentences.cn: 10月的一天，曹开始抱怨头疼、光线黑暗和视野模糊。

sentences.c: It was a good analogy; it whizzed round the world, prompting Putin to complain of US "arrogance".
sentences.cn: 这是个绝妙的比喻，很快传遍了全球，这让普金抱怨美国的“傲慢”。

sentences.c: Just the other day, a friend of mine begins to complain of the spam mails that she receives everyday.
sentences.cn: 几天前，我的一个朋友向我抱怨她每天都会收到很多垃圾邮件。

trans.cn: 全神贯注于…；全力以赴于…

sentences.c: We need to concentrate on our core business.
sentences.cn: 我们需要集中在核心业务上。

sentences.c: I am leaving to concentrate on writing fiction.
sentences.cn: 我要离开去专心写小说。

sentences.c: He is leaving the band to concentrate on his writing.
sentences.cn: 他要离开乐队去专职写作。

trans.cn: 由…组成
由……组成或形成：表示某物由若干部分或成分组成或构成。

sentences.c: Overall physical fitness is said to consist of five different elements.
sentences.cn: 全面的身体健康据称由以下五个不同的方面组成。

sentences.c: The DOMString type is explicitly specified to consist of wide UTF-16 characters.
sentences.cn: DOMString 类型被显式指定包括宽 UTF-16 字符。

sentences.c: if painting were to consist of merely copying the same lines, it would become boring;
sentences.cn: 如果画画只是复制同样的线条，它也会变得乏味；

trans.cn: 是…的原因；有助于，有益于

sentences.c: Would you like to contribute to our collection?
sentences.cn: 你愿意给我们的募捐捐款吗？

sentences.c: She began to host "Big Bosses" lunches, where she would try to persuade local business leaders to contribute to the cause.
sentences.cn: 她开始举办“大老板”午餐，在那里她会试图说服当地的商业领袖为这项事业做出贡献。

sentences.c: Unlike authoritarian management, some cultures, particularly in Asia, are well known for the consultative nature of decision-making—all members of the department or work group are asked to contribute to this process.
sentences.cn: 与专制管理不同，一些文化，特别是在亚洲，以决策的协商性质而闻名——部门或工作组的所有成员都被要求参与这一过程。

trans.cn: 证明…有罪，宣判…有罪

sentences.c: First the convict is dragged on a hurdle (a wooden frame) to the place of execution.
sentences.cn: 首先罪犯被绑在一个木框上，由一匹马后面拖着他到行刑地。 然后，罪犯上绞架，勒到快断气为止。

sentences.c: While it was once a shameful admission to have a convict ancestor, today it is more likely to be seen as a badge of honour.
sentences.cn: 以往，要承认自家先人犯过罪纵然是一件丑事，但在今天则有可能被视为一种褒奖。

sentences.c: The district attorney who prosecuted the case, Michael Jackson, said he planned to try to convict Mr. Fowler of murder but was satisfied with the less severe manslaughter ruling.
sentences.cn: 本案的公诉律师迈克尔，表示他原本觉得会判为谋杀，但对过失杀人这个判决结果感到满意。

word: to convince sb. to do sth

trans.cn: 说服某人做某事
对付；处理
应对，处理：处理或应对困难、挑战或压力的能力。

sentences.c: Fit people are better able to cope with stress.
sentences.cn: 健康的人较能应付压力。

sentences.c: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
sentences.cn: 不知怎么地，卡林设法应付了那些来自工作的要求。

sentences.c: We have taken on extra staff to cope with the increased workload.
sentences.cn: 我们已经额外雇用员工来应付增加了的工作量。

trans.cn: 给…提供消息，线索

sentences.c: Maps, charts, graphs and pictures are clues that will help the reader to cue in on the content and organization of the material.
sentences.cn: 各类舆图、图表、曲线图和图片都是很有用的线索，为匡助读者去理解所读的材料的内容和组织结构提供一些启示。

sentences.c: She stood in the wings and waited for her cue to go on.
sentences.cn: 她站在舞台侧面等待着出场的提示。

sentences.c: Without the external cue, the difference accumulates and so the internally regulated activities of the biological day drift continuously, like the tides, in relation to the solar day.
sentences.cn: 如果没有外界提示信号，这种差异就会积累，生物的日常内部调节活动就继续进行，像与太阳日有关的潮汐活动那样。

trans.cn: 赶上；振作；遵守；继续，保持

sentences.c: You need to cut down on starches.
sentences.cn: 你有必要少吃些含淀粉的东西。

sentences.c: The doctor told him to cut down on his drinking.
sentences.cn: 医生劝他少喝酒。

sentences.c: We're trying to cut down on the amount of paperwork involved.
sentences.cn: 我们正在努力降低有关此事的文书工作量。

trans.cn: 切去，割掉；切断，使孤立

sentences.c: The wicked stepmother told one of her two daughters to cut off her big toe to fit into the shoe.
sentences.cn: 那个邪恶的继母叫她的两个女儿中的一个把她的大脚趾剪下来，以适应鞋子的大小。

sentences.c: Despite objections by the White House, the Senate voted today to cut off aid.
sentences.cn: 尽管白宫反对，参议院今天投票中断援助。

sentences.c: One of the goals of the campaign is to cut off the elite Republican Guard from its supplies.
sentences.cn: 那场战役的目标之一就是切断精锐的共和国卫队的供给。

trans.cn: 迄今为止
- 迄今，到现在为止

sentences.c: Make sure your vaccinations are up to date.
sentences.cn: 一定要接种最新的疫苗。

sentences.c: To date, we have received over 200 replies.
sentences.cn: 到目前为止，我们已收到200多封回信。

sentences.c: Our computers are bang up to date.
sentences.cn: 我们的电脑是最先进的。

trans.cn: 与…接触；自…时代存在至今

sentences.c: My family has a vase, which is said to date back to Ming Dynasty.
sentences.cn: 我家有个花瓶，据说是从明代传下来的。

sentences.c: The stone circle is said to date back to 3200 BC and is a vision in itself.
sentences.cn: 它可以追溯到公元前3200年，是一处很独特的景点。

sentences.c: In Sanliurfa Province, outbreaks in backyard poultry are now thought to date back to late November 2005.
sentences.cn: 现认为在桑尼乌法省，后院家禽中的暴发始于2005年11月下旬。

trans.cn: 处理
处理：与某人交谈或会见某人，尤其是作为工作的一部分。

sentences.c: He has some unfinished business to deal with.
sentences.cn: 他还要处理一些尚未了结的事务。

sentences.c: We must take positive steps to deal with the problem.
sentences.cn: 我们必须采取积极步骤处理这个问题。

sentences.c: I prefer to deal with him direct.
sentences.cn: 我更愿意直接跟他打交道。

trans.cn: 关于…进行辩论

sentences.c: The class decided to debate on the housing question.
sentences.cn: 班级决定讨论房子问题。

sentences.c: The debate about megafauna pivots to a great degree on the techniques for dating old bones and the sediments in which they are buried.
sentences.cn: 关于巨型动物的争论在很大程度上取决于确定古老骨骼和埋藏它们的沉积物年代的技术。

sentences.c: He is expected to force a debate in Congress on his immigration reform.
sentences.cn: 他预期会推动一个关于他的移民改革的正式讨论。

trans.cn: 决定，选定

sentences.c: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
sentences.cn: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。

sentences.c: Denikin held a staff meeting to decide on the next strategic objective.
sentences.cn: 德尼金召开了员工大会为下一步的战略目标作出决定。

sentences.c: If the bride pays, she has the right to decide on the style of dress worn by her attendants.
sentences.cn: 如果新娘付费，她有权决定她的婚礼随员穿什么款式。

trans.cn: 否认…的…
依赖，依靠；依…而定
依赖某人或某物：指对某人或某物有所依赖，需要其支持或帮助。

sentences.c: Many farmers have to depend on subsidies to make a living wage.
sentences.cn: 许多农民不得不依靠补助来维持基本的生活需要。

sentences.c: You know, you are supposed to depend on yourself.
sentences.cn: 你知道的，你应该依靠自己。

sentences.c: I don't like to depend on my parents too much.
sentences.cn: 我不喜欢过多依赖我的父母。

trans.cn: 从…得到，源出于…

sentences.c: The complex style of the medieval wooden church carvings and the skills used to make them almost certainly to derive from the ancient Viking tradition.
sentences.cn: 几乎可以肯定，中世纪木制教堂雕刻的复杂风格和制作它们的技巧来自古代维京人的传统。

sentences.c: Modern musical scales are also said to derive from the Arabic alphabet.
sentences.cn: 音阶据说也源自阿拉伯字母表。

sentences.c: A key point to derive from this is that RPC style web services are simply a subset of document-style services in general.
sentences.cn: 从这里得出的要点是，rpc样式的Web服务一般只是文档样式的服务的一部分。

trans.cn: 对…意见不一

sentences.c: Morgan and Goldman appear to disagree about the answer.
sentences.cn: 摩根·斯坦利和高盛显然对此持否定态度。

sentences.c: A big agenda can give everyone something they want, but it can also give everyone something to disagree about.
sentences.cn: 一个庞大的计划固然能让每个人都从中得益，但也总能让人找出反对的理由。

sentences.c: It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonization within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonize.
sentences.cn: 它之所以陷入僵局，是因为欧元区的主导力量——法国和德国，都认为有必要在欧元区内部加强协调，但他们在协调哪些方面存在分歧。

trans.cn: 与…有分歧，不一致

sentences.c: I didn't feel able to disagree with him.
sentences.cn: 我觉得无法不同意他的意见。

sentences.c: He suspected that deep down, she admired him for having the gumption to disagree with her.
sentences.cn: 他认为，她内心深处其实钦佩他有魄力反对自己的意见。

sentences.c: Here's how to disagree with someone more powerful than you.
sentences.cn: 以下是如何向比你更有权力的人提出异议的方法。

trans.cn: 不同意

sentences.c: If parents are by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能不会喜欢她的来访。

sentences.c: If parents are angered by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能也不喜欢她回门拜访。

sentences.c: Protestant countries disapprove of cruelty to animals.
sentences.cn: 新教徒国家中反对虐待动物。

trans.cn: 不赞成
不赞成：表示对某人或某事表示反对或不满意的意思。

sentences.c: If you want to pick things to disapprove of, the rating agencies would be far down on the list.
sentences.cn: 如果你想要证明机构的误处，信用机构将不会在你考虑范围之内。

sentences.c: Paul is a meticulous taskmaster on a job site, and he tends to disapprove of my cutting corners - as I tried to do by reducing the concrete in the foundation.
sentences.cn: 在工地上，保罗是个谨慎的工头，他总是不同意我减少边角，因为我想要减少地基的混凝土。

sentences.c: If parents are by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能不会喜欢她的来访。

trans.cn: 分辨，区分

sentences.c: Phillip says it's important to distinguish between "person praise" and "process praise".
sentences.cn: 菲利普说，区分“对人的表扬”和“对过程的表扬”很重要。

sentences.c: It takes more than a brief encounter on a bus to distinguish between courteous convention and individual interest.
sentences.cn: 要区分礼貌习俗和个人兴趣，仅仅在公共汽车上的一次短暂邂逅是不够的。

sentences.c: One useful way is to distinguish between three degrees of poverty—extreme poverty, moderate poverty, and relative poverty.
sentences.cn: 一个有效的方法是区分三种程度的贫困——极端贫困、中等贫困和相对贫困。

trans.cn: 把…同…区分开

sentences.c: When they stop beating their wings, they'd be much harder for the bat to distinguish from a leaf or some other object.
sentences.cn: 当它们停止拍打翅膀，蝙蝠就很难将它们与一片树叶或者其他什么东西区分开。

sentences.c: Subspecies are often difficult to distinguish from one another.
sentences.cn: 区分不同的亚种是很困难的。

sentences.c: Human cases of H5N1 may be difficult to distinguish from other illnesses.
sentences.cn: H5N1型人类病例很难与其他疾病相区别。

trans.cn: 进行…的研究

sentences.c: It is significant to do research into the legal consciousness of citizens.
sentences.cn: 研究市民法律意识是有意义的。

sentences.c: He did not want to bake, so chose to do research into milky white opal glass.
sentences.cn: 他不愿意烘焙，所以选择研究乳白色的玻璃。

sentences.c: In view of that, I decide to do research into concrete practice in chemistry to search for the cause of chemistry learning disability and the strategies to solve it.
sentences.cn: 鉴于此，主试决定在我们化学学科当中、具体实践方面进行研究、探索中学生化学学习障碍的形成及相应解决策略。

trans.cn: 用做来源，依靠；临近

sentences.c: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to draw on our experience from the past.
sentences.cn: 为了人类的未来，我们必须借鉴过去的经验。

sentences.c: I'll have to draw on my savings.
sentences.cn: 我只得动用我的存款了。

sentences.c: Remember, whenever you want to draw on a sidewalk, always ask an adult in charge for permission before you draw.
sentences.cn: 记住，每当你想在人行道上画画时，在绘画之前一定要征得负责人的许可。

trans.cn: 梦见；梦想

sentences.c: Through reading, they are able to dream of a better life after war.
sentences.cn: 通过阅读，他们能够梦想战后更好的生活。

sentences.c: We begin to dream of new possible selves.
sentences.cn: 我们开始梦想新的可能的自我。

sentences.c: We were encouraged to dream of having our names in lights.
sentences.cn: 我们经常梦想着去拥有属于自己的一切。

trans.cn: 使…能够…

sentences.c: Failing to send the proper status code from your applications may seem harmless, but it can turn out to be a real problem when trying to enable to the edge server.
sentences.cn: 应用程序不发送正确的状态码看似没什么害处，但是在启用边缘服务器时这会成为真正的问题。

sentences.c: The king was on a private visit to enable him to pray at the tombs of his ancestors.
sentences.cn: 国王在做一次私访以便能祭拜其祖坟。

sentences.c: The interests he is most likely to enjoy will be those which enable him to show off himself or his talents.
sentences.cn: 他最有可能感兴趣的，是那些能让他自我炫耀或卖弄才华的事情。

trans.cn: 以…告终

sentences.c: They went in spring and planned to end in August.
sentences.cn: 他们春天出发，计划八月结束。

sentences.c: The programme was set to follow the U.S. space agency's shuttle missions, which are due to end in September.
sentences.cn: 该项目原本设定在美国宇航局的航天飞机任务后，后者将于9月结束。

sentences.c: The boom does not have to end in deflation.
sentences.cn: 繁荣并非一定以通货紧缩为终点。

trans.cn: 以…结束；以…告终

sentences.c: You don't want to end up with scrambled eggs!
sentences.cn: 你可不想要一个不成形的蛋饼吧！

sentences.c: You don't want regulated "utility" Banks to end up with all the worst people.
sentences.cn: 人们并不想以无能的人员来规范“高效”银行。

sentences.c: We do not have an [international] treaty but we still need to end up with clear global rules.
sentences.cn: 我们没有一项(国际)条约，但我们仍需最终制定出明确的全球规则。

trans.cn: 从事，忙于
参与某事：参与某项活动或行为。

sentences.c: Even in prison, he continued to engage in criminal activities.
sentences.cn: 他甚至在监狱里还继续从事犯罪活动。

sentences.c: It would be pointless to engage in hypothesis before we have the facts.
sentences.cn: 在我们还没掌握事实的情况下瞎猜是毫无意义的。

sentences.c: They can get chances to engage in research.
sentences.cn: 他们可以有机会从事研究。

trans.cn: 超出
过度；过分

sentences.c: I was reasonably fit, played a lot of tennis, and didn't smoke or drink to excess.
sentences.cn: 我那时很健康，常打网球，不过度抽烟或喝酒。

sentences.c: He started drinking to excess after losing his job.
sentences.cn: 他失业后便开始酗酒了。

sentences.c: But in one area, greenery might be taken to excess.
sentences.cn: 但有一个领域的绿色环保行为可能太过超前。

trans.cn: 暴露；面临；曝露

sentences.c: Next, add the seam: component tag inside of the definition of any Spring bean you would like to expose to JSF.
sentences.cn: 接下来，在任何您想要公开给JSF的Spring bean的定义内添加seam： component标记。

sentences.c: Others have existing functionality in legacy systems that they want to expose to clients, partners, and a service ecosystem.
sentences.cn: 而其他一些客户在遗留系统中拥有现有的功能，他们希望将其公开给客户、合作伙伴以及服务生态系统。

sentences.c: Decide on which WebSphere Application Server customization to expose to enable the image to be customized and reused in different environments.
sentences.cn: 决定公开哪个WebSphere Application Server自定义，以便能够在不同的环境中自定义和重新使用映像。

trans.cn: 半途而废，中途退出

sentences.c: Maybe the pajama trend is born of allowing some aspects of our lives to fall by the wayside in favor of other more important things than our appearance.
sentences.cn: 也许睡衣潮流的出现，是因为我们生活中的某些方面被其他比外表更重要的东西取代了。

sentences.c: Some things may have to fall by the wayside, but you want to get the most bang for your time buck.
sentences.cn: 有些事被迫放弃了，但你希望的是自己花的时间收获最大化。

sentences.c: Albert Gore Jr. apparently ready to fall by the wayside - he can focus on Jesse Jackson one-on-one.
sentences.cn: 在那儿-戈尔参议员已经差不多被淘汰了-他可以集中精力一对一与杰克逊周旋。

trans.cn: 对…怀恨
想（做某事），愿意

sentences.c: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
sentences.cn: 有这样的感觉是完全正常的。

sentences.c: He looked sufficiently like a king, but he was ill able to feel like one.
sentences.cn: 他外表看上去完全像个国王，但他不觉得自己像个国王。

sentences.c: It's going to feel like a made-up conversation that people don't necessarily want to tune in to.
sentences.cn: 这将会给别人一种刻意营造的对话的感觉，人们不一定愿意加入到对话中。

trans.cn: 摆弄，玩弄；弄虚作假

sentences.c: Where you get to fiddle with the script.
sentences.cn: 你可以在那儿摆弄脚本。

sentences.c: It probably is best not to fiddle with switches or controls when riding in the back seat of an air force plane.
sentences.cn: 坐在空军飞机的后座椅时最好不要随便拨弄任何开关或操纵装置。

sentences.c: But if the Fed wants to surprise the markets again, a more radical idea would be to fiddle with its own mandate.
sentences.cn: 但是如果美联储想要再度震惊市场，一个更激进的政策无异于是要去玩弄它的托管方。

trans.cn: 集中

sentences.c: This method gives you a goal to focus on.
sentences.cn: 这个方法给了一个可以让你专注的目标。

sentences.c: We turn from the disk subsystem to focus on the processors.
sentences.cn: 我们要将焦点从磁盘子系统转移到处理器上。

sentences.c: He prefers to focus on the positive.
sentences.cn: 他更愿意关注积极面。

trans.cn: 凝视，注视

sentences.c: If only to gaze at the life consciousness, what to do?
sentences.cn: 如果只为了凝视人生，要意识做什么呢？

sentences.c: Grab some guests and head outside to gaze at the Moon together, even if just for a few minutes.
sentences.cn: 找些客人和外面其他什么人一起好好看看月亮吧，哪怕只是几分钟呢。

sentences.c: I was going to. But she was beautiful and had suddenly begun to gaze at me with an unmistakable look of respect.
sentences.cn: 我正想这么说，发现漂亮的接待员正注视着我，毫无疑问用的是一种尊敬的眼神。

trans.cn: 摆脱，解脱，除去
摆脱，除去：消除或清除某物或某人。
解决，处理：处理或解决某个问题或困境。

sentences.c: I began to suspect (that) they were trying to get rid of me.
sentences.cn: 我开始觉察出，他们试图摆脱掉我。

sentences.c: I began to have a sinking feeling that I was not going to get rid of her.
sentences.cn: 我开始有一种摆脱不掉她的沮丧情绪。

sentences.c: We need to get rid of the idea that we must be liked all the time in order to be worthwhile.
sentences.cn: 我们需要摆脱那种必须一直受人爱戴才有价值的观念。

trans.cn: 交出，让出；放弃，抛弃，辞去
放弃：自愿放弃或放弃（某事物）；停止做或尝试某事。

sentences.c: He counselled them to give up the plan.
sentences.cn: 他建议他们放弃此项计划。

sentences.c: They'll have to give up completely on certain of their studies.
sentences.cn: 他们将不得不完全放弃某些课程。

sentences.c: You ought to give up smoking.
sentences.cn: 你应该戒烟。

trans.cn: 和…一起

sentences.c: Whatever the majority decided I was prepared to go along with.
sentences.cn: 不论多数人做何决定，我都准备好了遵从。

sentences.c: Leaders don't force other people but convince them to go along with them.
sentences.cn: 领导者不会强迫其他人赞同自己，但能说服别人。

sentences.c: I don't think it's vital to label GM ingredients in food, but I also wouldn't be against it—and industry would be smart to go along with labeling, just as a way of removing fears about the technology.
sentences.cn: 我不认为在食品中标注转基因成分是至关重要的，但我也不会反对——整个食品行业跟着贴标签的做法是明智的，这只是一种消除对这项技术的恐惧的方法。

trans.cn: 节食

sentences.c: I'm supposed to go on a diet.
sentences.cn: 我应该节食。

sentences.c: I’m supposed to go on a diet / get a raise.
sentences.cn: 我应该节食/涨工资。

sentences.c: To make myself look pretty again, I decide to go on a diet.
sentences.cn: 为了让自己更漂亮，我决定减肥。

trans.cn: 越过，渡过；仔细检查
转变为新的事物或新的做事方式：指改变现有的事物或做事方式，转向新的事物或新的做事方式。

sentences.c: He was reprimanded for trying to go over the heads of senior officers.
sentences.cn: 他因试图越过上级官员而遭严斥。

sentences.c: In Russia, people always take about a minute to go over things and plans in their minds before leaving.
sentences.cn: 在俄罗斯，人们总是在离开前花一分钟在脑子里捋一遍事情和计划。

sentences.c: Life is to go over and over again!
sentences.cn: 人生就是要一次次的超越！

trans.cn: 见鬼去（骂人用法）

sentences.c: Am I going to go to hell?
sentences.cn: 我会下地狱吗？

sentences.c: We have now been sentenced to go to hell.
sentences.cn: 我们现在也被打入地狱。

sentences.c: That's too bad. I want him to go to hell.
sentences.cn: 这太糟糕了，我想他去地狱。

trans.cn: 诉诸法律反对
控告某人：指通过法律途径对某人提起诉讼，寻求法律保护或解决争议。

sentences.c: I must admit I am rather unwilling to go to law against him.
sentences.cn: 我必须承认我很不愿意同他打官司。

sentences.c: She decided to go to law against her husband to have the dispute settled.
sentences.cn: 她决定去法院起诉丈夫以解决争端。

sentences.c: According to Xia Lin with Liaoning Renmin Law Firm, such contracts are not valid because the arrangement may be considered to go against moral law.
sentences.cn: 据来自辽宁人民律师事务所的夏琳（音）表示称，这样的合同是无效的，因为这样的安排可能会被视为违背了道德法则。

trans.cn: 走错路；失败，出毛病

sentences.c: The relationship started to go wrong when they moved abroad.
sentences.cn: 移居国外后，他们的关系开始出现问题了。

sentences.c: But then things started to go wrong.
sentences.cn: 但是，事情从此开始走向错误。

sentences.c: We do know that, when the balance is upset, things tend to go wrong.
sentences.cn: 我们知道，一旦平衡遭到破坏，事物就会偏离正轨。

trans.cn: 紧紧握住；依靠，求助于

sentences.c: The driver was unable to hang on to his lead.
sentences.cn: 这位车手没能守住自己的领先地位。

sentences.c: You can try to hang on to it or you can get over it.
sentences.cn: 你可以尝试一直想着它或者跨越它。

sentences.c: Don't allow yourself to hang on to any of these excuses.
sentences.cn: 不要让自己执着于这些借口了。

trans.cn: 把…挂起来；挂断（电话）；延迟，拖延
挂上电话：指在通话结束后将电话放回电话机或挂断电话。
延迟，拖延：指推迟或拖延某事的进行。
把……挂上：指将物体悬挂在某个支撑物上。

sentences.c: Perhaps her ladyship would like to hang up her own clothes today!
sentences.cn: 尊贵的夫人今天也许愿意动手自己把衣服挂起来吧！

sentences.c: I have to hang up.
sentences.cn: 我不得不挂机了。

sentences.c: They asked their experimenter to hang up the phone.
sentences.cn: 他们要求实验人员挂断电话。

synos.cn: 挂上电话；延迟，拖延；把……挂上

trans.cn: 垄断（某物）

sentences.c: I thought it was on this corner, but I seem to have made a mistake.
sentences.cn: 我本以为它在这个角落，但我好像弄错了。

sentences.c: Do you know which corner of a visiting card you must fold when leaving it with a footman in order to indicate that you have called on to inquire after the master's health?
sentences.cn: 你知不知道当你把名片留与仆人时，为了暗示你来拜访过主人给他请安，你必须折叠名片的哪一角？

trans.cn: 可接近，可进入

sentences.c: They want their parents to have access to affordable long-term care.
sentences.cn: 他们希望他们的父母可以得到负担得起的长期看护。

sentences.c: We pay a fee to have access to the Internet.
sentences.cn: 我们支付费用接入互联网。

sentences.c: This doesn't actually require you to have access to a network.
sentences.cn: 这并不会实际要求您能够访问网络。

trans.cn: 应付过去

sentences.c: ICBC appears to have an edge.
sentences.cn: 目前工商银行似乎占有一定优势。

sentences.c: Therefore you need to optimize constantly your websites and to have an edge over others you need to do something different and unique.
sentences.cn: 因此，你需要优化你的网站，并不断有其他优势对你需要做一些不同的和独特的。

sentences.c: Today, however, you need only two things in order to have an automatic edge: cash and courage.
sentences.cn: 不过现在，你只需要两样东西就能自然而然地获得优势；那就是现金和勇气。

trans.cn: 对…有影响

sentences.c: Changing the clocks, however, does not actually increase the amount of driving done in the dark, so it is unlikely to have any effect on Benovia's automobile accident rate.
sentences.cn: 然而，改变时钟实际上并不会增加在黑暗中驾驶的时间，所以它不太可能对 Benovia 的交通事故率有任何影响。

sentences.c: A country's capacity to produce wealth depends upon many factors, most of which have an effect on one another.
sentences.cn: 一个国家创造财富的能力取决于许多因素，其中大多数因素相互影响。

sentences.c: Few stop to think about the effect these devices may have on house guests.
sentences.cn: 很少有人会停下来思考这些设备可能对家中客人产生什么影响。

trans.cn: 对某事十分关心

sentences.c: To have mercy on someone is at the heart of human kindness.
sentences.cn: 对别人仁慈是人性之善的核心。

sentences.c: Getting enough sleep at night allows us to keep our heart health. You will have a healthier heart if you can get at least 7 hours of sleep every night.
sentences.cn: 晚上得到充足的睡眠可以让我们保持健康，同时，如果每晚能保证至少7个小时的睡眠，你将拥有一颗健康的心脏。

sentences.c: Sure, your heart will have to work at a higher heart rate for awhile when you run, which is good for heart health, but if your goal is calorie loss, it doesn't matter which one you do.
sentences.cn: 当然，你跑一英里的话，心跳会更快，这对你的心脏健康是有好处的。但是，如果你的目标只是单纯的想燃脂的话，无论是跑步或是走路都是可以的。

trans.cn: 与…一样有…

sentences.c: The only thing that the party's various factions seem to have in common is an obsession with junk food.
sentences.cn: 现在看来，党内各派唯一的共同点就是对垃圾食品的迷恋。

sentences.c: If you look at the people who've done great work, one thing they all seem to have in common is that they worked very hard.
sentences.cn: 如果你看看完成伟大的工作的人，他们共同点似乎都是非常努力地工作。

sentences.c: There are many reasons, but what they tend to have in common is they provide granularity of management of some aspect of the cluster.
sentences.cn: 这有许多原因，但最常见的原因是它们提供对集群的某些方面的粒度管理。

trans.cn: 与…有关

sentences.c: They are alert at bedtime and sleepy when it is time to get up, and this may have nothing to do with how fatigued their bodies are, or how much sleep they must take to lose their fatigue.
sentences.cn: 他们在睡觉的时候很清醒，到了该起床的时候很困倦，这可能与他们的身体有多疲劳，或者需要多少睡眠才能消除疲劳无关。

sentences.c: Their yawning seems to have nothing to do with sleepiness or boredom—quite the reverse—but it does precede a change in activity level.
sentences.cn: 他们打哈欠似乎与困倦或者无聊没有任何关系，但恰恰相反，打哈欠这一行为的确出现在了活动水平的变化之前。

sentences.c: This doesn't mean you have to cut out this delicious Japanese food together, but you do have to be careful with your choices.
sentences.cn: 这并不是说你必须把这种美味的日本食物一起去掉，但是你必须谨慎选择。

trans.cn: （对…）适用

sentences.c: Yet I also know that too much of a good thing can be rough, especially for young kids who hold themselves to impossibly high standards.
sentences.cn: 然而我还知道太过追求优秀有时会让人难受。尤其对于那些给自己制定过高标准的小孩子来说。

sentences.c: Central Banks are not only likely to keep their policy rates on hold for the foreseeable future, they may, for good measure, buy more bonds themselves.
sentences.cn: 在可以预见的将来，央行不止很可能将搁置利率变动的政策，再三考虑之后，他们还可能会自己购买更多的债券。

sentences.c: Are you equipped to have and hold and develop what you desire for good purposes?
sentences.cn: 你是否准备好了拥有并实现你所渴望的美好结果？

trans.cn: 把…看成

sentences.c: Although often overlooked, it is important to identify as many risks to your project as possible and be prepared if something bad happens.
sentences.cn: 常常被忽视，但是找出项目可能的风险，并准备好对策非常重要。

sentences.c: The real art in defining requirements is not to identify as many as possible, but to find the minimum set of requirements needed to satisfy the business problem.
sentences.cn: 定义需求的真正艺术并不是尽可能多的确定，而是找到能够满足业务问题的最小需求集合。

sentences.c: The growth is not because people are less likely to identify as religious, but because nonreligious people are more likely to say they are spiritual, says Duke sociologist Mark Chaves.
sentences.cn: “这种现象不是因为人们不愿意自认为宗教信仰者，而是因为无宗教信仰的人更愿意说他们有精神信仰。 ”DUKE社会学家马克·凯文斯说。

trans.cn: 把…和…等同起来

sentences.c: The writer clearly intends his readers to identify with the main character.
sentences.cn: 作者显然想使读者能与主人公产生共鸣。

sentences.c: But what really distinguished Disney was his ability to identify with his audiences.
sentences.cn: 但真正让迪士尼与众不同的是它与观众产生共鸣的能力。

sentences.c: Not everyone finds it so easy to identify with Gaza's population.
sentences.cn: 要想确定加沙目前的人口数量不是一件容易的事。

trans.cn: 使…铭记，牢记

sentences.c: I'm just trying to impress on the manager that he should pick me.
sentences.cn: 我只是尽力让主帅印象深刻，让他认为他应该选择我。

sentences.c: Georges father used to impress on him the needs to undergo all kinds of hardship in quest of excellence.
sentences.cn: 乔治的父亲过去经常向他强调必须经历各种艰难困苦去追求卓越。

sentences.c: George's father used to impress on him the need to undergo all kinds of hardship in quest of excellence.
sentences.cn: 乔治的父亲过去经常向他强调必须经历各种艰难困苦追求卓越。

trans.cn: 照看；留神；密切注意

sentences.c: We've asked the neighbours to keep an eye on the house for us while we are away.
sentences.cn: 我们已请邻居在我们离开时帮我们照看一下房子。

sentences.c: My parents set up a camera to keep an eye on me.
sentences.cn: 我的父母安装了一个摄像头来监督我。

sentences.c: Such stations will also be able to keep an eye on what is happening inside buildings, including offices.
sentences.cn: 这些监测站还将能够密切关注包括办公室在内的建筑物内发生的情况。

trans.cn: 同速前进；并驾齐驱

sentences.c: She found it hard to keep pace with him as he strode off.
sentences.cn: 他大步走开了，她感到很难跟上他。

sentences.c: The earnings of the average American have failed to keep pace with the rate of inflation.
sentences.cn: 一般美国人的收入跟不上通货膨胀的速度。

sentences.c: Overlords' income, despite the increase in rice production among their tenant farmers, failed to keep pace with their expenses.
sentences.cn: 尽管佃农的稻米产量有所增加，但地主们的收入仍跟不上他们的支出。

trans.cn: 假如；只要
保持同等水平或平衡：尽一切必要的努力与某人或某事保持同等水平或平衡。

sentences.c: It pays to keep up to date with your work.
sentences.cn: 工作能跟上时代是有利的。

sentences.c: She did not bother to keep up with the news.
sentences.cn: 她不愿操心去了解新闻。

sentences.c: She likes to keep up with the latest fashions.
sentences.cn: 她喜欢赶时髦。

trans.cn: 跟上（潮流，形势等）；保持联系

sentences.c: She did not bother to keep up with the news.
sentences.cn: 她不愿操心去了解新闻。

sentences.c: She likes to keep up with the latest fashions.
sentences.cn: 她喜欢赶时髦。

sentences.c: She is struggling to keep up with her schoolwork.
sentences.cn: 她在努力完成作业。

trans.cn: 记住

sentences.c: When you're giving feedback, it's important to keep in mind that no one likes to be told they're doing a bad job.
sentences.cn: 当你给予反馈时，重要的是要记住，没有人喜欢被告知他们的工作做得很糟糕。

sentences.c: That's the subtle distinction we need to try very hard to keep in mind.
sentences.cn: 那就是我们需要非常努力记住的微妙区别。

sentences.c: Last but not the least, a speaker has to keep in mind the value of brevity.
sentences.cn: 最后但并非最不重要的是，演讲者必须牢记简洁的价值。

trans.cn: 记住

sentences.c: Many people do not know the value of time. It (this) is indeed a great pity. We must bear (keep) in mind that wasting time is equal to wasting your life.
sentences.cn: 很多人不知道时间的价值。它(这)确实是一大遗憾。我们必须承担(保持)记住浪费时间等于浪费生命。

sentences.c: We must bear keep in mind that wasting time is equal to wasting your life.
sentences.cn: 我们必须记住浪费时间等于浪费生命。

sentences.c: Bear in mind though that when you do find a friend, you will need to pay to keep them - company comes at a cost, roughly 70 yuan an hour.
sentences.cn: 请记住，你需要花钱来找朋友，获得朋友的陪伴要付出代价，大约每小时70元。

trans.cn: 欺骗…去做…
在…方面缺乏

sentences.c: The problem is due to discipline, or, more precisely, the lack of discipline, in schools.
sentences.cn: 问题出在纪律上，或者更确切地说，是学校缺乏纪律。

sentences.c: There is a lack of confidence in the government's ability to manage the economy.
sentences.cn: 对政府管理经济的能力缺乏信心。

sentences.c: The most serious deficiency in NATO's air defence is the lack of an identification system to distinguish friend from foe.
sentences.cn: 北约防空的最大缺陷就是缺乏能够辨认敌友的识别系统。

trans.cn: 嘲笑；讥笑

sentences.c: He never used to laugh at all.
sentences.cn: 他以前根本就从来不笑。

sentences.c: Jenny had to laugh at her own foolishness.
sentences.cn: 珍妮只好自嘲自己的愚蠢。

sentences.c: Don't be unhappy if the people seem to laugh at your mistakes.
sentences.cn: 如果人们似乎在嘲笑你的错误，不要不高兴。

trans.cn: 把…放在一边，把…搁置一旁；留存

sentences.c: You ought to lay aside some money for future use.
sentences.cn: 你应该为将来积蓄些钱。

sentences.c: After defraying all the expenses, they were able to lay aside fifteen yuan each month.
sentences.cn: 在支付所有的开支以后，他们每月能积蓄十五元。

sentences.c: Samuel said to the cook, "Bring the piece of meat I gave you, the one I told you to lay aside."
sentences.cn: 撒母耳对厨役说:" 我交给你收存的那一分祭肉现在可以拿来。"

trans.cn: 导致；通向
导致：表示某种行为、事件或情况引发或导致另一种结果或后果。

sentences.c: His visit is expected to lead to the restoration of diplomatic relations.
sentences.cn: 他的访问预计会导致外交关系的恢复。

sentences.c: Nonconformity and stubbornness (and Yeats's level of arrogance and self absorption) are likely to lead to Conflicts with teachers.
sentences.cn: 不从众和固执（以及叶芝的傲慢和自我专注）有可能会导致与老师的冲突。

sentences.c: People will accept suffering that can be shown to lead to a greater good.
sentences.cn: 人们将会容忍能被证明会带来更大利益的苦难。

trans.cn: 由熟记而学某事

sentences.c: And finally, time was also found for Pandit Heramba Tatwaratna to come and get us to learn by rote rules of Sanscrit grammar.
sentences.cn: 最后，还找出时间让塔瓦拉纳先生来教我们死记硬背梵语语法。

sentences.c: Word is the foundation of learning English so you must start from word(I don't know your level)but I don't encourage you to learn by rote.
sentences.cn: 单词是学习英语的基本功，所以你必须从单词开始（当然这要视你的水平而定），但是我也不建议…

sentences.c: It makes more sense to learn the same way your brain is designed, by connecting ideas together into a web, rather than trying to store them with rote memorization.
sentences.cn: 使用构建你大脑的那种方式——将所有知识连结成一个网络，会比用死记硬背将知识储存起来的方式，更行得通。

trans.cn: 不管，不弄；更不用

sentences.c: Her income was barely enough to maintain one child, let alone three.
sentences.cn: 她的收入养活一个孩子几乎都不够，更不用说三个了。

sentences.c: It is incredible that the 12-year-old managed to even reach the pedals, let alone drive the car.
sentences.cn: 这个12岁的小孩能够得着踏板都令人难以置信，更不用说开汽车了。

sentences.c: Mastro Geppetto, in order to punish him for his mischief, let him alone the whole morning.
sentences.cn: 杰佩托师傅为了惩罚他的恶作剧，让他一个人呆了一上午。

trans.cn: 放手；放开

sentences.c: It's time to let go of the past.
sentences.cn: 该忘掉过去了。

sentences.c: You have to let go of your faith if you want to be a scientist.
sentences.cn: 如果你想成为一名科学家，你就必须放弃自己的信仰。

sentences.c: Research shows that consumers don't want to let go of any traditional product attributes, like convenience, price and quality.
sentences.cn: 研究表明，消费者不愿放弃任何传统产品属性，比如便利性、价格和质量。

trans.cn: 在于

sentences.c: "People are also more likely to lie in real time—in an instant message or phone call—than if they have time to think of a response," says Hancock.
sentences.cn: 汉考克说：“人们在即时通话中撒谎的可能性，包括发信息或打电话，也比他们有时间考虑如何回复时的可能性大。”

sentences.c: I'm perfectly content just to lie in the sun.
sentences.cn: 我在阳光下躺着就感到非常满足。

sentences.c: Earlier last year, I liked to lie in bed and watch videos instead of studying.
sentences.cn: 去年早些时候，我喜欢躺在床上看视频，不喜欢学习。

trans.cn: 使明亮，发亮

sentences.c: The lamp takes energy from a plant growing in a wooden box and uses it to light up an LED light bulb.
sentences.cn: 这种灯从生长在一个木箱里的植物中获取能量，然后用它来点亮一个 LED 灯泡。

sentences.c: Electronic cigarettes - a safe way to light up?
sentences.cn: 电子香烟——安全的吸烟方式？

sentences.c: Drivers who forget to light up at night often cause accidents.
sentences.cn: 晚上忘记开车灯的司机常常出车祸。

trans.cn: 靠…生活
靠……生活：依靠某种金额或资源来维持生活。

sentences.c: For example, they don't like to live on the thirteenth floor.
sentences.cn: 例如，他们不喜欢住在第十三层楼。

sentences.c: They are still having to live on very low incomes.
sentences.cn: 他们仍然不得不靠微薄的收入为生。

sentences.c: The family was forced to live on credit from local merchants.
sentences.cn: 这家人不得不靠向当地的商家赊账过活。

trans.cn: 照顾；照看；照料
照顾或负责某人或某事：指关心、照料、保护或负责某人或某事。

sentences.c: It makes sense to look after yourself.
sentences.cn: 照顾好你自己是明智的。

sentences.c: Your baby depends on you to look after yourself properly while you are pregnant.
sentences.cn: 你的宝宝靠你怀孕时好好照顾你自己。

sentences.c: He had to look after them.
sentences.cn: 他必须照顾他们。

trans.cn: 向前看；展望未来

sentences.c: Now it's time to look ahead to 2011.
sentences.cn: 现在，是时候展望2011年了。

sentences.c: Now, we have to look ahead to Inter.
sentences.cn: 现在，我们必须考虑对国米的比赛。

sentences.c: To forgive about what might have been and to look ahead to what can be.
sentences.cn: 是时候忘记原本可能发生的事，而向前展望可能发生的故事。

trans.cn: 在字典、参考书中查找

sentences.c: She just grunted, not deigning to look up from the page.
sentences.cn: 她只咕哝了一声，继续看书，不屑抬起头来看一眼。

sentences.c: Users will be able to use their handhelds to look up timetables on the net, search for a local hotel, and check their bank accounts.
sentences.cn: 用户将能够使用掌上装置查阅网上时刻表，搜索当地旅馆并核对他们的银行账户。

sentences.c: I want to look up the word. Could you lend me a dictionary?
sentences.cn: 我想查这个词。你能借我一本字典吗？

trans.cn: 正视

sentences.c: I'll never be able to look her in the face again!
sentences.cn: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

sentences.c: He spent a lot of time with children in the hospital, and often put a special red nose on his face to look like a clown and to make the children laugh.
sentences.cn: 他在医院里花了很多时间和孩子们在一起，经常把一个特别的红鼻子戴在脸上，看起来像个小丑，逗孩子们笑。

sentences.c: So Lavie did another experiment, designed to look at this ability to concentrate better in the face of increased difficulty.
sentences.cn: 因此，拉维做了另一个实验，旨在观察这种在难度增加时能够更好地集中注意力的能力。

trans.cn: 要求…

sentences.c: If your request is for information about a child, please contact the registrar to find out how to make such a request.
sentences.cn: 如果你寻求的是有关孩子的信息，请与登记员联系以获知如何作这样的请求。

sentences.c: As an example of an API request, you will make a request to retrieve the friends for the authenticated user. Recall the structure of a Graph API.
sentences.cn: 作为一个API请求的例子，您将发出一个请求，为经过身份认证的用户检索好友。

sentences.c: The reason for this (as mentioned earlier) is that with raw sockets you need to establish a new connection for every request that you make to the server.
sentences.cn: 其原因(早些时候曾经提到过)是，用原始套接字，您需要为您向服务器作的每个请求建立一个新连接。

trans.cn: 有影响，起（重要）作用

sentences.c: I wanted to make a difference in the world somehow, but I had no idea how to do that.
sentences.cn: 我想以某种方式在世界上有所作为，但我不知道该怎么做。

sentences.c: Want to make a difference to our planet?
sentences.cn: 想要改变我们的星球吗？

sentences.c: Tom wants to make a difference to the education system.
sentences.cn: 汤姆想改变教育体系。

trans.cn: 猜测

sentences.c: Would it be beyond a philosopher's research, think ye, gentlemen, to analyse that child's nature, and, from its make and mould, to give a shrewd guess at the father?
sentences.cn: 先生们，请你们想一想，耍分析这孩子的天性，要根据她的体态和气质来对她的父亲作出聪明的猜测，是不是超出了哲学家的研究范畴了呢？

sentences.c: More precisely, the TTS engine can make a pretty good guess at pronouncing most anything you can spell and give it, but the recognizer must have a pronunciation for the words to be recognized.
sentences.cn: 更精确地说是，TTS引擎可以比较准确地猜到你能拼写出的任何词的发音，并将这种发音赋予该词，但识别器却必须有要识别的词的发音。

sentences.c: Experienced photographers guess pretty well at the settings that will work in a given environment, but even they check to make sure.
sentences.cn: 有经验的摄影师们可以在特定环境下估计出基本准确的参数来进行拍摄，但即使是他们，也会靠查看照片来确认。

trans.cn: 承诺；献身于，投入

sentences.c: He questioned the government's commitment to peace and called on it to make a gesture of good will.
sentences.cn: 他质疑政府的和平承诺，并呼吁其摆出善意姿态。

sentences.c: She doesn't want to make a big emotional commitment to Steve at the moment.
sentences.cn: 她不想在此刻对史蒂夫在感情上作出重大的承诺。

sentences.c: What sort of commitment do I have to make to use this treatment?
sentences.cn: 我需要做出什么样的承诺才能使用这种治疗方法?

trans.cn: （财产）转让，移交；改造，重做

sentences.c: He asked the tailor to make over his dress.
sentences.cn: 他请裁缝为他改做衣服。

sentences.c: Never try to make over your wife or husband.
sentences.cn: 永远不要试图改造你的老婆或老公。

sentences.c: Clay hated the abolitionists and the great noise they were beginning to make over slavery.
sentences.cn: 克莱憎恨废奴主义者和他们所带来的噪声，他们正在奴役他人。

trans.cn: 有意义

sentences.c: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.
sentences.cn: 这些数据不应孤立起来看，否则就没有意义。

sentences.c: They tried to make sense of her mumblings.
sentences.cn: 他们试图听明白她在嘟哝些什么。

sentences.c: Provided you didn't try to make sense of it, it sounded beautiful.
sentences.cn: 只要你不试图理解，它听起来是美的。

trans.cn: （由部分）组成，构成（全体）；捏造，虚构

sentences.c: Everyone gets a chance to make up tests.
sentences.cn: 每个人都有一次补考的机会。

sentences.c: We need one more person to make up a team.
sentences.cn: 我们还需要一个人才能组成一个队。

sentences.c: They have nineteen days to make up their minds.
sentences.cn: 他们有十九天的时间来做出决定。

trans.cn: 下决心

sentences.c: Irresolution means reluctance or an inability to make up one's mind.
sentences.cn: 优柔寡断指犹豫不决，举棋不定不愿或不能决定。

sentences.c: Look upon this story as a means of limbering up one's senses, one's attitude and one's mind to make them pliable and receptive.
sentences.cn: 这个故事可以让人的知觉、态度和心智变得柔韧、灵活和敏感，更容易接受新的事物。

trans.cn: 错把…当做…

sentences.c: On the surface, it had been easy to mistake for tenderness, but the more I thought about it the more there seemed to be something condescending in it, even meant to humiliate.
sentences.cn: 表面上，这很容易被误解为亲昵，但我越想，越觉得这是一种高人一等的表现，甚至是有意羞辱我。

sentences.c: I'm not going to sit around and take the blame for a mistake he made.
sentences.cn: 我不会闲坐着，为他犯的错误承担责任。

sentences.c: The bank refuses to accept responsibility for the mistake.
sentences.cn: 银行拒绝为这一错误承担责任。

trans.cn: 无济于事
毫无结果：表示努力或尝试没有取得任何成果。

sentences.c: His efforts were to no avail.
sentences.cn: 他的努力是徒劳的。

sentences.c: The doctors tried everything to keep him alive but to no avail.
sentences.cn: 医生千方百计想使他活下来，但无济于事。

sentences.c: He had the receptionist almost jumping through hoops for him. But to no avail.
sentences.cn: 他让接待员为他几乎饱经折磨，但根本没有用。

trans.cn: 对某人有利
对某人有利：表示对某人有益或有利。

sentences.c: To have the license number of one's automobile as low as possible is a social advantage in America.
sentences.cn: 为自己的汽车领一块尽可能小号码的车牌，在美国是表示社会上的优越地位的。

sentences.c: Died basically, unless they have infinite STH used to one's own advantage.
sentences.cn: 基本死了，除非他们有无限的资本。

sentences.c: To get away from one's working environment is, in a sense, to get away from one's self; and this is often the chief advantage of travel and change.
sentences.cn: 从某种意义上，离开自己的工作环境即是离开原先的那个自己，这是旅行带来的一大主要的好处。

trans.cn: 打开；开办，开辟，开发；坦诚地谈话

sentences.c: Lorna found that people were willing to open up to her.
sentences.cn: 洛娜发现人们愿意向她敞开心扉畅谈。

sentences.c: It helps to discuss your problems but I find it hard to open up.
sentences.cn: 与人谈谈自己面临的问题固然有益，但我觉得有些话很难说得出口。

sentences.c: Several customers were waiting when I arrived to open up the shop.
sentences.cn: 我到店里开门时，几个顾客已在等侯。

trans.cn: 决定不参加…，决定（从…）退出

sentences.c: The wrong kind of leadership will lead to what Cialdini calls "captainitis, the regrettable tendency of team members to opt out of team responsibilities that are properly their."
sentences.cn: 错误的领导方式会导致西奥迪尼所说的“队长病”，即团队成员选择逃避本应属于他们的团队责任，这是一种令人遗憾的倾向。

sentences.c: Critics say the digital access codes represent the same profit seeking ethos of the textbook business, and are even harder for students to opt out of.
sentences.cn: 批评人士说，数字接入码代表着教科书行业同样的逐利风气，让学生更难选择退出。

sentences.c: Critics say the digital access codes represent the same profit-seeking ethos of the textbook business, and are even harder for students to opt out of.
sentences.cn: 批评人士说，数字准入码等同于教育行业的逐利风气，其让学生更难抽身其中。

trans.cn: 注意
注意：关注某事物，集中精力在某事物上。

sentences.c: How to pay attention to mental health?
sentences.cn: 怎样关注健康呢？

sentences.c: Teachers need to pay attention to students.
sentences.cn: 教师需要注意学生。

sentences.c: It's better to pay attention to your spelling.
sentences.cn: 最好注意你的拼写。

trans.cn: 偿还；没有白费

sentences.c: I need to pay off all my debts before I leave the country.
sentences.cn: 我得在离开该国前偿清所有债务。

sentences.c: It would take him the rest of his life to pay off that loan.
sentences.cn: 还清那笔贷款将花费他的余生。

sentences.c: The firm will be able to pay off its debts and still turn a modest profit.
sentences.cn: 该公司将能够还清其债务，而且还会稍有赢利。

trans.cn: 付出代价

sentences.c: He's quite willing to pay the price I ask.
sentences.cn: 他很愿意照我的要价付钱。

sentences.c: I know I have to pay the price.
sentences.cn: 我知道我会付出代价。

sentences.c: As long as you are willing to pay the price.
sentences.cn: 只要你能付得起他们的价格。

trans.cn: 累积；（指若干车辆）碰撞在一起

sentences.c: When the air gets closer to the shore, it's slowed down by the land and starts to pile up.
sentences.cn: 当空气接近海岸时，陆地会减缓它的速度并使其在此堆积。

sentences.c: But we don't want B to pile up.
sentences.cn: 但我们不想让B积聚起来。

sentences.c: Slowly, the money began to pile up.
sentences.cn: 慢慢地，钱凑齐了。

trans.cn: 钉住；使受约束，牵制；准确说明

sentences.c: It has taken until now to pin down its exact location.
sentences.cn: 一直到现在才确定了它的准确位置。

sentences.c: The cause of the disease is difficult to pin down precisely.
sentences.cn: 病因目前还难以解释清楚。

sentences.c: He set out with an apparently simple aim: to pin down the precise meaning of the concept of "information".
sentences.cn: 他的出发点显然很简单：确定“信息”这个概念的确切含义。

trans.cn: 为某人谋方便；有利于某人
恳求；请求

sentences.c: He opens to speed a car on the road that day and the detection has to plea for help signal in front.
sentences.cn: 那天他开着奔驰车在路上，发现对面有个求救信号。

sentences.c: Mr Gyurcsany had a second plea: for eastern countries to secure early membership of the single currency.
sentences.cn: 此外久尔恰尼还提出了另一项请求，希望能确保东欧国家能早日加入单一货币体系。

sentences.c: They helped persuade the father of one murdered man to make a moving-and successful-plea for calm.
sentences.cn: 他们帮助说服了一名受害人的父亲，让他动容地呼吁民众平静下来——而且成功了。

trans.cn: 防御（危险；敌人等）

sentences.c: Concrete bricks to protect from radiation.
sentences.cn: 巨大混凝土砖，保护人体以免辐射。

sentences.c: Such people usually wear socks to protect from contact with materials.
sentences.cn: 这类人群往往也可以通过穿袜子来避免过敏症状。

sentences.c: Cover the burn with clean, non-fluffy material to protect from infection.
sentences.cn: 用干净的没有绒毛的材料包扎伤口来防止感染。

trans.cn: 赡养，为…提供必需品
供养，照顾：为某人提供生活所需，包括食物、住所、医疗等。
预先考虑，预留：在计划或安排中预先考虑到某种情况或需求。

sentences.c: The Strasbourg conference's main concern was to provide for the future.
sentences.cn: 斯特拉斯堡会议主要关注的是为未来做好准备。

sentences.c: I have done my share these last four years and now it is your turn to provide for her.
sentences.cn: 过去四年我尽了自己的一份力量，现在轮到你来养活她了。

sentences.c: She had tried to provide for the child elsewhere, and at last she had found a splendid chance for her.
sentences.cn: 她曾试图把这个孩子领到别的地方抚养，她终于找到了一个极好的机会。

trans.cn: 给某人提供…

sentences.c: With provision of submersibles, to train pilots for underwater vehicle. Provide professional training services to vehicle's owners or somebody interested in underwater operation.
sentences.cn: 在提供潜水器产品的同时，培训潜水器操作驾驶人员，为潜水器业主或者有志于水下操作驾驶的个人提供专业的培训服务。

trans.cn: 拆除；推翻
拆除，拆毁：指将建筑物、结构等拆除或拆毁。
拉下，拖下：用力将某物向下拉或拖。

sentences.c: It is easier to pull down than to build up.
sentences.cn: 拆房容易盖房难。

sentences.c: Michael continues trying to pull down on the pipe, but it won't budge.
sentences.cn: Michael继续试图撬动那条管道，但是根本没用。

sentences.c: I always have this wicked urge to pull down their pants when I see this "look".
sentences.cn: 当我看到这些人，我忍不住想把他们的裤子拉下来。

trans.cn: 结束或废除某事务

sentences.c: There have been continual demands to put an end to this situation.
sentences.cn: 人们不断要求要结束这种局面。

sentences.c: Under the new Northern Territory law, an adult patient can request death—probably by a deadly injection or pill—to put an end to suffering.
sentences.cn: 根据新的北领地法律，成年病人可以要求死亡——通过注射或服用致命药丸来结束痛苦。

sentences.c: I felt that I had got to put an end to that dreadful noise.
sentences.cn: 我深感有必要结束那折磨人的噪音。

trans.cn: 放在一边，撇开储存
放置一边：将某物暂时放在一边，不再使用或处理。

sentences.c: They decided to put aside their differences.
sentences.cn: 他们决定搁置双方的分歧。

sentences.c: In order to take advantage of these common-sense solutions, Americans will have to put aside their own attachment to the idea of smaller government and less regulation.
sentences.cn: 为了利用这些常识性的解决方案，美国人将不得不抛弃缩小政府规模和减少监管的想法。

sentences.c: The teachers in the program described how they found it difficult to put aside the immediate demands of others in order to give themselves the time they needed to develop their reflective skills.
sentences.cn: 参加这个项目的老师们描述了他们是如何发现自己很难把他人的即时需求放在一边，以便有足够的时间来增强自己的反思技能。

trans.cn: 延期；消除
推迟，延迟：指将计划或安排推迟到以后的时间。

sentences.c: We've had to put off our wedding until September.
sentences.cn: 我们只得把婚期推迟到九月。

sentences.c: Mr. Bint has a propensity to put off decisions to the last minute.
sentences.cn: 宾特先生有一种将决定拖到最后一分钟的倾向。

sentences.c: Some believe this level of compensation is essentially a poison pill to put off any rival bidders.
sentences.cn: 一些人相信这种程度的补偿本质上是一个毒丸策略，旨在阻止一切竞标对手。

synos.cn: 推迟，延期；驶出，出发；消除

trans.cn: 提出以供…；举起，抬起
搭建，建造：将某物建立起来，通常指临时性的建筑或结构。
提供住宿：为某人提供临时的住宿。
忍受，容忍：容忍某人或某事，尤指令人不悦的事情。

sentences.c: She was in no mood to put up with Blanche's carping.
sentences.cn: 她当时没有心情容忍布兰奇的吹毛求疵。

sentences.c: My girlfriend Geraldine is a saint to put up with me.
sentences.cn: 我的女友杰拉尔丁是个能包容我的圣人。

sentences.c: I'm not going to put up with their smoking any longer.
sentences.cn: 我再也不能容忍他们抽烟了。

trans.cn: 忍受，容忍
忍受：指容忍或忍耐某事或某人的行为。
容忍：指接受或容忍某事或某人的存在或行为。

sentences.c: She was in no mood to put up with Blanche's carping.
sentences.cn: 她当时没有心情容忍布兰奇的吹毛求疵。

sentences.c: I'm not going to put up with their smoking any longer.
sentences.cn: 我再也不能容忍他们抽烟了。

sentences.c: It's a crying shame that police have to put up with these mindless attacks.
sentences.cn: 警察不得不容忍这些无谓的攻击，真是件太令人遗憾的事。

trans.cn: 有记录；列入记录；将…列入记录

sentences.c: If lessor or tenant have, just be harbor, bay, the person of mesa area or foreigner, lessor was about to put on record to Beijing land natural resources and building management board.
sentences.cn: 假如出租人或承租人有一方是港、澳、台地区的人或者外国人，出租人就要到北京市国土资源和房屋治理局备案了。

sentences.c: I made a quick run to the market, put sheets on the guest bed and set the TV to record the Warriors' game, so if traffic was awful, he wouldn't have to miss the first half.
sentences.cn: 我飞快地跑到市场，把床单铺在客人的床上，并把电视调好，录下了勇士队的比赛，这样即使交通很糟糕，他也不会错过上半场了。

sentences.c: About 12 weeks before your first exam, record the dates and times for each of your exams in your planner or diary and make a copy to put on your wall at home.
sentences.cn: 在你第一次考试前12周，把每一次考试的日期和时间记录在你的计划或日记本上，并拷贝一份贴在家里的墙上。

trans.cn: 对…做出反应；因受影响而改变行动

sentences.c: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
sentences.cn: 在过去十年左右的时间里，科技的进步让 Zara 、H&M 和优衣库等大众品牌能够更快地对潮流做出反应，更准确地预测需求。

sentences.c: Someone allergic to milk is likely to react to cheese.
sentences.cn: 对牛奶过敏的人可能会对奶酪也有不良反应。

sentences.c: I just don't know how to react to it.
sentences.cn: 我都不知道自己应该如何反应才好。

trans.cn: 提到，涉及；参考，查阅

sentences.c: Do you think it's reliable to refer to rating websites?
sentences.cn: 你认为参考评级网站可靠吗？

sentences.c: And then there those who, not knowing what questions are coming at them, and having no resources to refer to, can freeze.
sentences.cn: 然后，那些不知道会遇到何种题目，也没有资源可以参考的人，可能会整个人呆在那里。

sentences.c: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
sentences.cn: 我答应过再不提这事了。

trans.cn: 称…为…

sentences.c: This is what I like to refer to as your mental foundation.
sentences.cn: 这就是我要提到您的心理基础。

sentences.c: There are always the old Petty cash pages to refer to as examples.
sentences.cn: 总还是有一些旧的小额现金账页可供作为实例查询。

sentences.c: But through the use of IBM Rational Method Composer, this process tailoring can be formally described and published in HTML for any project team member to refer to as part of their role.
sentences.cn: 但是通过IBM Rational Method Composer使用，这种处理过程裁剪能够以HTML被更加正式的描述和发布给任何一个团队成员。

trans.cn: 仔细考虑，反思

sentences.c: She was left to reflect on the implications of her decision.
sentences.cn: 由她负责考虑她这个决定会牵扯哪些问题。

sentences.c: The start of a new year is a good time to reflect on the many achievements of the past.
sentences.cn: 新年伊始正是回顾过去许多成绩的好时候。

sentences.c: Over the next few years many people had occasion to reflect on the truth of his warnings.
sentences.cn: 在随后的几年里许多人有机会反思他那些警告的真相。

trans.cn: 与…有关系
与……有关：找到或展示两个或更多事物之间的联系。

sentences.c: He is unable to relate to other people.
sentences.cn: 他不能够与别人沟通。

sentences.c: Since an "only" tends to be a well-adjusted individual, she'll eventually learn to relate to any chosen spouse.
sentences.cn: 由于“独生子女”的适应能力往往很强，她最终可以学会适应任何一个选择的配偶。

sentences.c: One of the positive effects it has on our lives, I think, is our ability to relate to others through the Internet.
sentences.cn: 我认为它对我们生活的积极影响之一是使我们能够通过互联网与他人取得联系。

trans.cn: 使…想起…

sentences.c: I got this card to remind you of your birthday.
sentences.cn: 我买这张卡片是要提醒你的生日到了。

sentences.c: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of wine?
sentences.cn: 你能提醒我买一瓶葡萄酒吗？

sentences.c: Daytime television tended to remind her too forcefully of her own situation.
sentences.cn: 白天的电视往往太过强烈地使她想到自己的处境。

trans.cn: 研究
进行……的研究：指对某个主题或问题进行深入的调查和研究。

sentences.c: But what sets it apart is further responsibility to research into upcoming technological trends with regard to the organization's growth.
sentences.cn: 但其不同之处是研究组织的未来增长趋势的进一步职责。

sentences.c: Like last week in the library, we decided to split up the research into 3 parts and then each of us was supposed to find sources in the library for our parts.
sentences.cn: 就像上周在图书馆，我们决定把研究分成三部分，然后我们每个人本应该在图书馆为各自的部分寻找资料。

sentences.c: I'm going to talk today about research into a particular species of bird—the New Caledonian crow, whose natural habitat is small islands in the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.cn: 我今天要讲的是对一种特殊鸟类的研究——新喀里多尼亚乌鸦，它的自然栖息地是太平洋上的小岛。

trans.cn: 作答，回答；对…作出反应，响应

sentences.c: The best way to respond to a flame is to ignore it.
sentences.cn: 回应攻击性电子邮件的最好方式就是置之不理。

sentences.c: The world community has been slow to respond to the crisis.
sentences.cn: 国际社会对该危机的反应向来迟缓。

sentences.c: You can rely on him to respond to a challenge.
sentences.cn: 你可以信赖他，他懂得应付挑战。

trans.cn: 依赖，依靠

sentences.c: Perhaps I created laurels to rest upon.
sentences.cn: 也许，我造了长青树好在上面休息。

sentences.c: Then Abraham said, depart, depart from me, for I desire to rest upon my couch.
sentences.cn: 然后亚伯拉罕说，离开，离开我，因为我渴望休息后，我躺在沙发上。

sentences.c: Gannet - to subsist by the wings of his virtue and merit, having little land to rest upon.
sentences.cn: 塘鹅-以自己美德和功绩为党羽而继续生存的人，流落而没有定所。

trans.cn: 发生；因…引起，起因于

sentences.c: The complications frequently accompanying diabetes, such as impairment of vision and of kidney function, are now thought to result from the lack of continuous control of blood glucose concentrations.
sentences.cn: 现在认为糖尿病经常伴有的并发症，如视力和肾功能损害，是由于缺乏对血糖浓度的持续控制所致。

sentences.c: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
sentences.cn: 这种情况似乎是由许多因素的累积的结果，而大气污染物是主要的罪魁祸首。

sentences.c: In the case of NBA players, their increase in height appears to result from the increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.
sentences.cn: 拿 NBA 球员来说，他们身高的增加似乎是由于从世界各地招募球员的做法越来越普遍。

trans.cn: 抢某人之财物
排除
排除：官方决定或声明某事不可能发生，或者某事物或某人不合适。

sentences.c: He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
sentences.cn: 他拒绝排除增税的可能性。

sentences.c: Physical and eye examinations, with special attention to cardiac and blood-pressure problems, should be performed annually to rule out serious medical conditions.
sentences.cn: 每年应进行身体和眼睛检查，特别注意心脏和血压问题，以排除严重的疾病。

sentences.c: She refused to rule out speculation that this was General Younes.
sentences.cn: 有猜测指这人就是尤尼斯将军，对此她拒绝加以排除。

trans.cn: 用尽

sentences.c: Fears that the world was about to run out of fuel proved groundless.
sentences.cn: 担心地球燃料即将用尽被证明是没有根据的。

sentences.c: It is easy for families to run out of money before the weekly giro arrives.
sentences.cn: 每周直接转账救济支票还未到钱便花光的情况许多家庭都容易出现。

sentences.c: Soon, the money began to run out and they couldn't afford the lessons anymore.
sentences.cn: 很快，钱被用完了，他们再也负担不起这些课程了。

trans.cn: 向…献祭；为…而牺牲；为…而失去

sentences.c: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD."
sentences.cn: 他说：“为平安来的，我是给耶和华献祭。”

sentences.c: It's a question of how much you're prepared to sacrifice to get inside television.
sentences.cn: 为了进入电视圈，你多大程度上做好了牺牲的准备。

sentences.c: The LORD said, "Take a heifer with you and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD."'
sentences.cn: 耶和华说：“你可以带一只牛犊去，就说：‘我来是要向耶和华献祭。”’

trans.cn: 搜寻，搜查，探察

sentences.c: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.
sentences.cn: 你可以使用目录服务在因特网上搜索人。

sentences.c: For example, police use it to search for bad guys.
sentences.cn: 例如，警察用它来搜索坏人。

sentences.c: Thousands of people come to search for the scenes (场景) in the novel.
sentences.cn: 成千上万的人前来寻找小说中的场景。

trans.cn: 抓住；占有

sentences.c: The wrestlers try to seize hold of each other.
sentences.cn: 摔跤选手未能抓住对手的胳膊。

sentences.c: As you gradually learn to do this, even the most turbulent emotions fail to seize hold of you and instead dissolve, as wild waves rise and rear and sink back into the calm of the ocean.
sentences.cn: 当你慢慢做此修炼时，就算是最强烈的情绪也无法纠缠你，也会溶化；如同巨浪生起、高耸，而又沉没回到海洋的宁静中。

sentences.c: To seize hold of the market, game companies and operator must go into investigation and analyze the datum by the Numbers. It is the premise to decide the capacity and requirement of the servers.
sentences.cn: 游戏公司和运营商要正确地把握市场导向，需要对市场进行调查和系统化分析，以确定游戏服务器容量和需求。

trans.cn: 使从…分离（分开，隔开）

sentences.c: Junior high school days are over and it's hard to separate from our dear teachers and friends.
sentences.cn: 初中的日子已然结束，与亲爱的老师和朋友们分开实属不易。

sentences.c: Guangyao's family – like Tingting's parents – insist they had no choice but to separate from their son.
sentences.cn: 光耀的父母和婷婷的父母一样，坚决认为他们别无选择，只能离开他们的儿子。

sentences.c: In other words, the desire to be with the lover is much stronger than the desire to separate from the husband.
sentences.cn: 也就是说，想要和恋人在一起的渴望远强于想要和丈夫分离。

trans.cn: 适合
充当，担任：扮演某种角色或起到某种作用。

sentences.c: She was elected to serve as secretary of the local party.
sentences.cn: 她当选为地方党组织的书记。

sentences.c: Her job was to serve as a gatekeeper, a human shield for the technicians.
sentences.cn: 她的工作是当一个看门人——技术员的人盾。

sentences.c: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm's board.
sentences.cn: 外部董事应当成为公司董事会得力又客观的顾问。

trans.cn: 留出，拨出；忽视，不顾

sentences.c: She tries to set aside some money every month.
sentences.cn: 她每个月都尽量存点钱。

sentences.c: He urged the participants to set aside minor differences for the sake of achieving peace.
sentences.cn: 他敦促与会者把小分歧抛于脑后，以求实现和平。

sentences.c: It's much wise to set aside some time to accompany parents or do something more meaningful.
sentences.cn: 留出一些时间陪伴父母或做一些更有意义的事情是很明智的。

trans.cn: 出发，起程；宣布，发表；展示，陈列

sentences.c: People now in many big cities have to set out early to avoid the heavy traffic in the morning.
sentences.cn: 现在许多大城市的人们不得不早早地出发以避开早晨的交通拥挤。

sentences.c: The troops are about to set out.
sentences.cn: 部队就要出发了。

sentences.c: The simplest definition of success is to set out to do something and to succeed in doing it.
sentences.cn: 成功最简单的定义就是着手去做一件事，并成功地完成它。

trans.cn: 设立，建立；建立，提出
建立：正式建立一个新的公司、组织、系统、工作方式等。

sentences.c: We decided to set up camp for the night.
sentences.cn: 我们决定搭帐篷过夜。

sentences.c: The machine is a doddle to set up and use.
sentences.cn: 这机器的安装和使用都很简单。

sentences.c: Our first task is to set up a communications system.
sentences.cn: 我们的首项任务是架设通信系统。

trans.cn: 把…作为目标

sentences.c: Given the special requirements of space use and of varied missions, no particular set of systems or features can be specified as essential to achieve this objective.
sentences.cn: 鉴于空间使用和各种航天任务的特殊要求，不可能把任何一套特定的系统或特点规定为实现这一目的所必须的。

sentences.c: The company try to set the improvement of quality as their objective.
sentences.cn: 这个公司把提高质量作为他们的目标。

sentences.c: OBJECTIVE: Take the rehabilitation education to help the patients set up conformable life style so as to improve the quality of life.
sentences.cn: 目的：采用康复教育的手段，帮助患者建立适合的生活方式，以期提高其生活质量。

trans.cn: 躲开，回避；赞成

sentences.c: You don't need to shy away from the honor. You deserve it in your own right.
sentences.cn: 你不用躲这个荣誉，你有资格得到它。

sentences.c: Bad: It is easy to shy away from the XML Schema syntax when it is unfamiliar.
sentences.cn: 不好的方法：当您对 XML Schema 语法不熟悉的时候，就很容易出现回避它们的情况。

sentences.c: Many other countries and international organizations have begun to shy away from dam building.
sentences.cn: 许多国家和国际组织都已开始对修建大坝敬而远之。

trans.cn: 反对

sentences.c: She had to sit down on the dry, hard ground and look down into the valley and all about her.
sentences.cn: 她不得不坐在干燥坚硬的地面上，俯视着山谷和周围的一切。

sentences.c: "Then we must invite her to sit down on the beautiful green lounge of grass," quietly answered the old man.
sentences.cn: “那我们就必须邀请她坐那张铺着绿草垫的漂亮长沙发了。”老人平静地回答。

sentences.c: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
sentences.cn: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上。

trans.cn: 在某种程度上
在某种程度上；部分地

sentences.c: To some extent this was the truth.
sentences.cn: 在某种程度上这是事实。

sentences.c: To some extent what she argues is true.
sentences.cn: 她的论证在某种程度上是符合事实的。

sentences.c: Biography must to some extent delineate characters.
sentences.cn: 在某种程度上，传记一定要描述人物。

synos.cn: 在一定程度上；在某种程度上

trans.cn: 分类，整理

sentences.c: Let's try to sort out the mess.
sentences.cn: 我们来收拾一下残局吧。

sentences.c: The police were called to sort out a domestic.
sentences.cn: 已叫警察来解决家庭纠纷。

sentences.c: We urged them to sort out the problem sooner rather than later.
sentences.cn: 我们敦促他们及早解决那个问题。

trans.cn: 整理，把…分类

sentences.c: Their specific task is to sort through the reams of information and try to determine what it means.
sentences.cn: 他们的具体任务就是将大量信息分类，并努力弄清其意思。

sentences.c: For group decision-making to work well, you need a way to sort through the various options they propose: and you need a mechanism to narrow down these options.
sentences.cn: 要想让团队决策发挥作用，你需要有一种方法来梳理他们提出的各种方案，你还需要一种机制来缩小这些选择的范围。

sentences.c: What's the best way to sort through the details on sunscreens?
sentences.cn: 如何整理一大堆关于防晒霜的信息？

trans.cn: 谈起，提到
值得一提：足够重要或显著，值得一提。

sentences.c: She can speak German and French, not to speak of English.
sentences.cn: 她能说德语和法语，更不用说英语了。

sentences.c: They've got no friends to speak of.
sentences.cn: 他们没一个像样的朋友。

sentences.c: She's saved a little money but nothing to speak of.
sentences.cn: 她攒了一点钱，不过数目不值一提。

trans.cn: 含义很深，很有意义

sentences.c: If they are at all questioning your love for them, this gesture is going to speak volumes to them, because they are probably very certain about how you feel about whatever it is you give up for them.
sentences.cn: 如果他们都质疑你对他们的爱是，这个姿态是想说卷的他们，因为他们可能是非常肯定的对你的感受不管它是你放弃了他们。

sentences.c: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
sentences.cn: 正如破译密码在西班牙的战争中有着更广泛的意义一样，他试图晋升的努力也充分说明了英国社会的情况。

sentences.c: The answers to these simple questions can speak volumes about complex psychological process.
sentences.cn: 对这些简单问题的回答，可以充分说明我们的心理过程。

trans.cn: 专门从事
专营，专门研究：指在某个领域或某种活动中具有专门的知识、技能或经验。

sentences.c: A small segment of the urban society started to specialize in nonagricultural tasks as a result of the city's role as a regional center.
sentences.cn: 由于该城市是区域的中心，城市社会中的一小部分人开始专门从事非农业工作。

sentences.c: A college education will enable me to specialize in a certain field of knowledge, such as medicine or law, preparing me to become a professional.
sentences.cn: 大学教育将使我能够专注于某些领域的知识，例如医学或法律，让我成为专业人士。

sentences.c: After I did my engineering degree, I began to specialize in computer technology.
sentences.cn: 读完工程学位后，我就开始专攻计算机技术。

trans.cn: 思索；推测，猜测

sentences.c: This has led scientists to speculate on the existence of other galaxies.
sentences.cn: 这就使得科学家推测还有其他星系存在。

sentences.c: He likes to speculate on the stock market.
sentences.cn: 他喜欢炒股。

sentences.c: He refused to speculate on the possible effects on relations between the two governments.
sentences.cn: 他拒绝猜测这对两国政府关系可能产生的影响。

trans.cn: （使）加快速度
加速：发生或移动更快，或使某事发生或移动更快。

sentences.c: Action had been taken to speed up the release of cheques.
sentences.cn: 已采取行动来加速支票的发放。

sentences.c: Increasing gravity is known to speed up the multiplication of cells.
sentences.cn: 为人所知的是，不断增加的重力会加速细胞数量的递增。

sentences.c: We become insensitive to our experience, which means we process less information, and time seems to speed up.
sentences.cn: 我们对自己的经历变得不敏感，这意味着我们处理的信息更少，而时间似乎在加速。

trans.cn: 分裂，分开；吵架，离婚

sentences.c: The band have reportedly decided to split up.
sentences.cn: 据说这个乐队已经决定解散。

sentences.c: Like last week in the library, we decided to split up the research into 3 parts and then each of us was supposed to find sources in the library for our parts.
sentences.cn: 就像上周在图书馆，我们决定把研究分成三部分，然后我们每个人本应该在图书馆为各自的部分寻找资料。

sentences.c: The salient question is whether to split up the user data into multiple table Spaces or not.
sentences.cn: 突出的问题在于是否要将用户数据分割到多个表空间中。

trans.cn: 没有可能；没有希望

sentences.c: The main goal: to make sure that no matter which rung on the ladder a person occupies, they stand at least a fighting chance of making it to the rung above them - provided they truly deserve it.
sentences.cn: 主要目标是：以确保无论哪个响的阶梯上占有一个人，他们至少有战斗的机会使它向他们敲响以上-提供他们真正得到它。

sentences.c: There are too many "temples" and each has too many "deities". Veteran comrades stand in the way and younger people have no chance to come forward.
sentences.cn: 现在的庙很多，每个庙里的菩萨也很多，老同志盖住了，年轻人上不来。

trans.cn: 转过脸去不理睬某人，避开某人

sentences.c: The trip is scheduled to start on December 21 in New York City and continue on to Milan, Prague, Paris, Bangkok and New Delhi before ending in Toronto on January 8.
sentences.cn: 这次旅行计划于12月21日在纽约开始，然后继续前往米兰、布拉格、巴黎、曼谷和新德里，1月8日在多伦多结束。

sentences.c: When it was near sunset, the doctor rose to start on his way down.
sentences.cn: 太阳快落山的时候，医生站了起来，开始往下走。

sentences.c: When are you going to start on your journey?
sentences.cn: 你们哪天去旅行啊？

trans.cn: 附着，粘住

sentences.c: Don't expect me to stick to the job just because it pays a few more bucks.
sentences.cn: 别指望我只为多挣几块钱就坚持工作下去。

sentences.c: She finds it impossible to stick to a diet.
sentences.cn: 饮食老受限制，她觉得受不了。

sentences.c: I managed to stick to the diet and keep off sweet foods.
sentences.cn: 我设法坚持节食，不吃甜食。

trans.cn: 坚持；继续

sentences.c: They decided to stick with their original plan.
sentences.cn: 他们决定继续执行原来的计划。

sentences.c: More than half of Australian homes are still choosing to stick with their home phone.
sentences.cn: 超过一半的澳大利亚家庭仍然选择保留他们的座机。

sentences.c: If you love to swim or dance, you may find it easier to stick with an exercise program that is built around these activities.
sentences.cn: 如果你喜欢游泳或跳舞，你会发现更容易坚持以这些活动为基础的锻炼计划。

trans.cn: 阻止…做

sentences.c: So to stop from shopping on Black Friday, you may need to top up with a late-night Turkey club.
sentences.cn: 因此，要想阻止自己在黑色星期五疯狂购物，你或许还要在午夜好好准备做火鸡。

sentences.c: So to stop from shopping on Black Friday, you may need to top up with a late-night turkey club. And start the day with a turkey scramble.
sentences.cn: 因此，如果你想在黑色星期五这天保住自己的荷包，最好在前一天晚上就把火鸡准备好，这样第二天一早你就能大快朵颐来抑制自己的购物欲了。

sentences.c: I grabbed his arm to stop myself from falling.
sentences.cn: 我抓住他的手臂以免自己摔倒。

trans.cn: 用…代替…

sentences.c: Today we have different kinds of music to substitute for the flute but you get the point.
sentences.cn: 今天我们听不同的音乐，取代了长笛，但你可以想象一下。

sentences.c: It's really too bad that the teacher couldn't find someone to substitute for her when She was sick.
sentences.cn: 她生病时，老师找不到人代替她，实在太可惜了。

sentences.c: These measures correlate with pain, but nothing has been accurate enough to substitute for self-reports.
sentences.cn: 这些测量确实和疼痛有关，不过没有一项能准确到代替自我报告。

trans.cn: 吸收，吸出，吸起

sentences.c: There wasn’t a Hoover in the world big enough to suck up all that shit.
sentences.cn: 世界上可没有足够大的真空吸尘器能把那些毒物吸光。

sentences.c: Another way would be growing algae in the ocean to suck up carbon dioxide.
sentences.cn: 另外一种办法是可以通过在海洋里种植藻类来吸收二氧化碳。

sentences.c: The heavier bodied base of the machine often remains still while the long hose moves around to suck up dirt.
sentences.cn: 它沉重的底座留在地上，而连接在上面的橡皮软管却能四处移动打扫灰尘。

trans.cn: 受苦，受害，受罚，受损失；患病

sentences.c: But even if the poaching of carnivorous plants can be halted, they will continue to suffer from other assaults.
sentences.cn: 但是，即使能够停止对食肉植物的偷猎，它们仍将遭受其它的攻击。

sentences.c: I began to suffer from headaches, which left me feeling completely drained.
sentences.cn: 我开始感到头痛，它使我感到精疲力竭。

sentences.c: Teenagers who are addicted to the Internet are more likely to suffer from depression.？
sentences.cn: 有网瘾的青少年更有可能患上抑郁症。

trans.cn: 吞没，耗尽

sentences.c: Lighting matches just to swallow up the flame like me?
sentences.cn: 你会像我一样点燃火柴只为吞噬火焰？

sentences.c: The two firms wanted to combine together to swallow up ours.
sentences.cn: 那两家公司想联合起来吞并我们公司。

sentences.c: It is said that there was a dragon in the sky. The dragon wanted to swallow up the moon.
sentences.cn: 据说天上有一条龙，它要把月亮吞下去。

trans.cn: 免费搭车

sentences.c: A free ride Because of the inconvenient transportation, people went back home always needed to hitch a ride. When a truck stopped, lots of people went towards it and wanted to take a ride.
sentences.cn: 搭车由于交通不便，时常要搭顺路的货车回家。一旦有车停下，就会有人争先恐后地攀爬而上。

sentences.c: "We heard about Didi Dache every day in the news, so we wanted to sort of take a free ride on its fame," said the head of Joke's business department, who would give only his surname, Yuan.
